members.name: Cathy Stanley
members.headline: Founder/CEO
members.bio:
Hi everyone, I'm looking forward to meeting other learners!  

I run a small non profit dog rescue organization in Los Angeles and I am struggling to juggle the administrative tasks, fundraising, marketing of adoptable dogs, running the social media, in addition to the physical offline tasks of rescuing dogs from shelters, taking them back and forth to vet appointments, meeting adopters, etc.  My hope is that I can create an A.I. process to help me to streamline many tasks and become more efficient with my time.

Some specific areas that I hope to streamline are:
- updating our website with fresh content/adoptable dog photos/videos, etc.
- creating content for social media that can be formatted for each platform and scheduled ahead
- automatically downloading any livestreams that I do and have those long form videos edited into short form clips for social media
- fundraising is my biggest need
- grant writing & grant submissions
- Meta ads for fundraising and getting dogs adopted
- getting the most of out of my CRM (Bloomerang) to help me to automate some donor relations
- creating custom videos featuring an AI clone of myself, to use as outreach for donors
- gamification for getting more social media engagement, especially around my fundraising posts
- automating adoption anniversaries to have past adopters contacted
- moving my bookkeeping from a volunteer who manually is entering everything into Quickbooks and automate and itemize expenses
- learning to create AI videos to promote our adoptable dogs (I want to make one of our longterm dogs do a "podcast" where he interviews each of our adoptable dogs to ask them what their likes are and what kind of home they are looking for)
- learning to create AI educational videos (dog training, nutrition, puppy socializing, child/dog safety tips, medical issue explainers, etc.)
- would like to develop a better system for labeling and storing all of the media (I have a massive amount of pics/videos that I take on a daily basis that are stored in a google photo album but I am needing to manually label everything and create new albums for each dog, there must be a more efficient way to save me time)
- I have a new website that was just built and launched a few weeks ago, I would like to learn how to take advantage of the possibilities to automate updating the website with fresh  pics/videos several times a week, if not daily (without having to manually do it)
- I would like to learn how to edit long form videos faster (I currently use Final Cut Pro but I know there are AI models to help speed up my editing)
- I would like to learn how to use AI to create videos from still photos of our adoptable dogs, to make them look realistic and natural, showing them in various situations to make them appealing to potential adopters (or to make comical videos to get the attention of potential adopters)

members.name: Larry Thompson
members.headline: CEO
members.bio:
Transforming Real Estate Transactions Through Innovation
With over two decades of experience spanning mortgage lending, real estate brokerage, and title insurance, I've built my career at the intersection of traditional real estate services and cutting-edge technology solutions.
As Branch Manager at American Financial Network for the past 10 years (23 years total in mortgage lending), I've helped countless families achieve homeownership while gaining deep insights into the pain points that plague real estate transactions.
My real estate journey expanded in 2018 when I moved Venture Realty, LLC under the eXp Realty umbrella, allowing our team to leverage a broader network while maintaining our commitment to exceptional client service.
Recognizing inefficiencies in the title insurance industry, I founded Affiliated Title Ventures, LLC in 2018, where we've pioneered new approaches to client acquisition and service delivery in what has traditionally been a commodity business.
Building the Future: Schedule Ventures INC
Today, I'm most excited about Schedule Ventures INC and our flagship platform, ScheduleClosings.com – a revolutionary marketplace that's reimagining how real estate professionals and consumers connect with closing agents. Think Zillow, but for finding, researching, and booking attorneys and title companies.
We're reversing the traditional "pretty girls with donuts" sales model. Instead of title companies begging attorneys for business, our platform empowers attorneys to market themselves while automatically routing title insurance orders to our licensed partners. It's a win-win-win: consumers get transparency and convenience, attorneys get qualified leads, and title companies get systematic deal flow.
Launching nationwide in late 2025, Schedule Closings represents just the beginning. Our vision extends to creating a comprehensive ecosystem for all real estate service needs – from inspections to surveys and beyond.
Core Values
Faith-driven leadership • Customer-first innovation • Operational excellence through technology
Education: BS Finance – Clemson University 1994   MBA UNC Charlotte 1999
Always open to connecting with forward-thinking real estate professionals, potential JV partners, and fellow entrepreneurs who believe technology should simplify, not complicate, the path to homeownership.

members.headline: Owner
members.bio:
# Terence Washington

Terence Washington brings a rare perspective to charter school finance: he's spent more than a decade inside the regulatory system that most school leaders struggle to navigate.

As a founding team member of Georgia's State Charter Schools Commission, Terence spent ten years building the infrastructure that now governs charter school financial accountability across the state. He architected the charter school performance framework, designed the annual monitoring process, and provided the analytical foundation for Georgia's landmark HB787—legislation that fundamentally changed how charter schools are funded.

Perhaps most notably, Terence co-created the nation's first charter school financial management certificate program with the University of Georgia's Carl Vinson Institute of Government, training a generation of school leaders in fiscal compliance and strategic finance.

In 2020, Terence transitioned from shaping policy to solving problems. As owner of CharterFiGuy LLC, he now provides fractional CFO services, financial reporting, and back-office solutions to charter schools, authorizers, and educational boards. His clients benefit from something competitors can't replicate: intimate knowledge of how charter school compliance actually works, what regulators look for, and how to build systems that withstand scrutiny while supporting mission.

Terence holds a B.B.A. in accounting from Georgia State University and has presented at national conferences on charter school finance. When he's not working, you'll find him hiking, adventure biking, or at live music venues across the Southeast.
